# Conscious
Python CLI (no deps) with two modes:
1. Journal: `python app.py add "text"`, `summary`, `trend`, `reflect` (keyword mood scoring, themes, ASCII trend).
2. Tutor mode: `import app; app.tutor('Ava','missed homework')` logs session notes; `python app.py monthly Ava` prints a parent-ready monthly summary with recurring struggles.
Scoring is keyword-based, not an LLM. Sample data: tutor.json.
## Demo
python app.py monthly Ava
